newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba says court rebuffs Zeneca patent case.
newsitem.headline: Ciba says court rebuffs Zeneca patent case.

text.p: Swiss chemical company Ciba-Geigy AG said a German court had rejected a patent infringement claim filed against its German subsidiary by Zeneca Plc.

The case concerned the crop protection product with the brand name Agil, whose active ingredient is the herbicide propaquizafop. Zeneca claimed that propaquizafop infringed on a patent held by ICI Austrlia, Ciba said in a statement.
It said Zeneca had appealed against a German Federal Patents Court ruling in November that significantly limited the ICI patent.

Ciba said the Munich state court ruling was the second one to go against Zeneca, which it said had filed patent infringement suits against Ciba in six countries. In April the Copenhagen city court denied Zeneca's request for a preliminary injunction against Ciba's sales of Agil in Denmark, it said.
